issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'lòe loẹt' (gaudy/flashy) to describe the clothing, which is not present in the Greek text ('ιματιων').

The Vietnamese translates 'κοσμος' as 'sự của thế gian' (things of the world/worldly things), whereas the Greek 'κοσμος' in this context refers to 'adornment' or 'decoration'. The translation shifts the meaning from the nature of the adornment to its origin.
